verses.ar: «كَيْفَ أَعَنْتَ مَنْ لَا قُوَّةَ لَهُ، وَخَلَّصْتَ ذِرَاعًا لَا عِزَّ لَهَا؟
verses.kjv: How hast thou helped [him that is] without power? [how] savest thou the arm [that hath] no strength?
verses.web: “How have you helped him who is without power! How have you saved the arm that has no strength!

verses.ar: كَيْفَ أَشَرْتَ عَلَى مَنْ لَا حِكْمَةَ لَهُ، وَأَظْهَرْتَ ٱلْفَهْمَ بِكَثْرَةٍ؟
verses.kjv: How hast thou counselled [him that hath] no wisdom? and [how] hast thou plentifully declared the thing as it is?
verses.web: How have you counseled him who has no wisdom, and plentifully declared sound knowledge!

verses.ar: لِمَنْ أَعْلَنْتَ أَقْوَالًا، وَنَسَمَةُ مَنْ خَرَجَتْ مِنْكَ؟
verses.kjv: To whom hast thou uttered words? and whose spirit came from thee?
verses.web: To whom have you uttered words? Whose spirit came out of you?

verses.kjv: Dead [things] are formed from under the waters, and the inhabitants thereof.
verses.web: “The departed spirits tremble, those beneath the waters and all that live in them.

verses.ar: ٱلْهَاوِيَةُ عُرْيَانَةٌ قُدَّامَهُ، وَٱلْهَلَاكُ لَيْسَ لَهُ غِطَاءٌ.
verses.kjv: Hell [is] naked before him, and destruction hath no covering.
verses.web: Sheol is naked before God, and Abaddon has no covering.

verses.ar: يَمُدُّ ٱلشَّمَالَ عَلَى ٱلْخَلَاءِ، وَيُعَلِّقُ ٱلْأَرْضَ عَلَى لَا شَيْءٍ.
verses.kjv: He stretcheth out the north over the empty place, [and] hangeth the earth upon nothing.
verses.web: He stretches out the north over empty space, and hangs the earth on nothing.

verses.ar: يَصُرُّ ٱلْمِيَاهَ فِي سُحُبِهِ فَلَا يَتَمَزَّقُ ٱلْغَيْمُ تَحْتَهَا.
verses.kjv: He bindeth up the waters in his thick clouds; and the cloud is not rent under them.
verses.web: He binds up the waters in his thick clouds, and the cloud is not burst under them.

verses.ar: يَحْجُبُ وَجْهَ كُرْسِيِّهِ بَاسِطًا عَلَيْهِ سَحَابَهُ.
verses.kjv: He holdeth back the face of his throne, [and] spreadeth his cloud upon it.
verses.web: He encloses the face of his throne, and spreads his cloud on it.

verses.ar: رَسَمَ حَدًّا عَلَى وَجْهِ ٱلْمِيَاهِ عِنْدَ ٱتِّصَالِ ٱلنُّورِ بِٱلظُّلْمَةِ.
verses.kjv: He hath compassed the waters with bounds, until the day and night come to an end.
verses.web: He has described a boundary on the surface of the waters, and to the confines of light and darkness.

verses.ar: أَعْمِدَةُ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ تَرْتَعِدُ وَتَرْتَاعُ مِنْ زَجْرِهِ.
verses.kjv: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his reproof.
verses.web: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his rebuke.

verses.ar: بِقُوَّتِهِ يُزْعِجُ ٱلْبَحْرَ، وَبِفَهْمِهِ يَسْحَقُ رَهَبَ.
verses.kjv: He divideth the sea with his power, and by his understanding he smiteth through the proud.
verses.web: He stirs up the sea with his power, and by his understanding he strikes through Rahab.

verses.ar: بِنَفْخَتِهِ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتُ مُسْفِرَةٌ وَيَدَاهُ أَبْدَأَتَا ٱلْحَيَّةَ ٱلْهَارِبَةَ.
verses.kjv: By his spirit he hath garnished the heavens; his hand hath formed the crooked serpent.
verses.web: By his Spirit the heavens are garnished. His hand has pierced the swift serpent.

verses.ar: هَا هَذِهِ أَطْرَافُ طُرُقِهِ، وَمَا أَخْفَضَ ٱلْكَلَامَ ٱلَّذِي نَسْمَعُهُ مِنْهُ وَأَمَّا رَعْدُ جَبَرُوتِهِ فَمَنْ يَفْهَمُ؟».
verses.kjv: Lo, these [are] parts of his ways: but how little a portion is heard of him? but the thunder of his power who can understand?
verses.web: Behold, these are but the outskirts of his ways. How small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power who can understand?”
